0022600095.text: The Mavericks (0-1) have yet to win this season and sit 14th in the West and 5th in the Southwest, while the Pacers (1-0) have won their only game so far and sit 7th in the East and 2nd in the Central. Dallas won both meetings in 2025-26, including a 134-130 road win in Indianapolis on February 22, 2026, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. The Mavericks are without Dereck Lively II (out, foot surgery), and Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Jett Howard (calf), Santi Aldama (knee) and Tarik Biberovic (heel) are listed as day-to-day, while the Pacers are missing Johnny Furphy (out, knee surgery) and have Aaron Nesmith (hamstring strain) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring) listed as day-to-day.
